calculateSchedule5MethodB is labelled 'Method B(ii)', but its steps are the ATO's Method A. It uses the current period's regular gross, divides by the pay periods in the year, takes the difference, multiplies back and caps at 47%. ATO Method B(ii) instead uses 'average total earnings ... over the current financial year to date' and adds earlier B(ii) payments, then subtracts amounts already withheld. The output is a valid ATO method ("Calculations made using either method are acceptable"), so the figures are not wrong. Only the name and doc comment are. Proposed change (owner of payg-withholding.ts): change the comment/section header to 'Schedule 5, Method A'. Renaming the function is an engine change that needs a decision. No change made.
